title: Experiency Bosses
description: Experiency Bosses is a datapack that brings forth four legendary foes, each bearing unique treasures—from the Axolotl lurking in the ocean’s depths to the Wither Skeleton King, crowned in shadow.
body:
# Minecraft Vanilla Bosses!

## Bosses:
- **Wither Skeleton King**
![Wither Skeleton King](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5186797f92e41cb8534ee5fd690fff769049e993_0.webp)

- **Matriarch Spider**
![Matriarch Spider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34f44153a7d36014fcc8d478ca3428f7929e01d7.jpeg)

- **Malgosh the Piglin**
![Malgosh the Piglin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/175402fd0091ab81faf627a8ef0abe4902ce213b_0.webp)

- **The Absolute Axoloth**
![The Absolute Axoloth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36a723acc70edb914ba2f294d38c7e49b4f37025.jpeg)

## Custom Items:
- Crown of Bones
- Spider Back
- Malgosh Crossbow
- Axolotl Tierpiercer

## Commands
### Spawn Bosses:
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/spawn_wither_skeleton_king
```
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/spawn_matriarch_spider
```
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/spawn_malgosh_the_piglin
```
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/spawn_the_absolute_axoloth
```


### Items:
To obtain the items, you must defeat the bosses.
If you want to obtain them using commands, use:

```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/give_crown_of_bones
```
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/give_spider_back
```
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/give_malgosh_crossbow
```
```
/function experiency_bosses:admin/give_axoloth_tidepiercer
```
